summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Also changed _ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri). Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership (positive, proper-prefix negative, self, SH), closed membership for RDFS (defined term, undefined term sharing base, plain string and Literal negatives) and RDF (rdf:type). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. Changes are uncommitted.
